State Life’s objective is a modern, trustworthy digital front door (corporate website) paired with a secure, integrated customer self-service portal that measurably reduces walk-in/call-center dependency while improving policyholder experience. We understand the scope spans UX/UI, build, integrations, deployment to your cloud environment, and one-year support under defined response times.

Functionally, the portal must allow authenticated policyholders to (i) view policy information, (ii) download documents, (iii) raise and track service requests, and (iv) make online premium payments, with end-to-end integration to the existing core policy system via REST APIs and to a payment gateway. We recognize that “success” for State Life means these journeys are simple on mobile and desktop, role-based access is enforced, and user actions are auditable to support security and operational governance.

From a delivery standpoint, we understand you require:
- Content-managed corporate website enabling non-technical content updates and structured publishing workflows.
- Responsive, accessible UI aligned to WCAG 2.1 AA expectations.
- Secure authentication and role-based access controls for the portal.
- One-year warranty/O&M with a helpdesk and defined critical-issue response times.

We also recognize the compliance context: ISO 9001 and ISO 27001 are mandatory and are held by TechnoCore Engineering (Pvt) Ltd [CO-PROFILE]. We are SECP incorporated and hold FBR NTN with Active Taxpayer (ATL) status [CO-PROFILE], and can arrange bid security as a CDR/bank guarantee from scheduled banks within our facility [CO-PROFILE].

Our project library evidences multiple large-scale software deliveries (e.g., LMS Development and ERP implementations) above PKR 5M within the last five years [CAP-010][CAP-046][CAP-050]; if your evaluation requires specific web-portal completion certificates in a prescribed format, our library does not yet include those artifacts, and we will provide the required documentary evidence with the bid submission.
